messages:
david: Customer hit spike of 504s and high FD usage after we rolled go-sdk v0.9.0. They say calls cancel quickly (client side) and then errors accumulate.

maria: can you share repro? sounds like context cancel + transport config issue.

david: repro attached below. small load test that cancels ctx after 150ms. netstat showed many ESTABLISHED->CLOSE_WAIT increase. logs: "context canceled" and sometimes "http: TLS handshake error from client".

kevin: quick questions — which go version and are they passing a custom http.Client into the SDK or using default? also sdk version?

maria: the usual suspects: not closing resp.Body on retries, Transport keepalives, and the SDK retry middleware re-issuing requests after context cancel.

david: they are on go1.19, using sdk v0.9.0, and they call NewClient(WithHTTPClient(customClient)). Transport config:

```
\tt := &http.Transport{
\t\tMaxIdleConns: 100,
\t\tMaxIdleConnsPerHost: 50,
\t\tIdleConnTimeout: 90 * time.Second,
\t\tTLSHandshakeTimeout: 10 * time.Second,
\t}
\tclient := &http.Client{Transport: t}
\n\tctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 150*time.Millisecond)
\tdefer cancel()
\treq, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "GET", url, nil)
\tresp, err := client.Do(req)
\tif err != nil { log.Println(err); return }
\tdefer resp.Body.Close()
\tio.ReadAll(resp.Body)
```

kevin: thanks. two likely issues: 1) SDK retries may ignore original ctx cancellation and attempt a retry without closing previous resp.Body -> leak. 2) Using short context + long IdleConnTimeout can keep sockets open.

sam: workaround while we investigate: set Transport.DisableKeepAlives = true OR call client.Transport.(*http.Transport).CloseIdleConnections periodically. Also try using http.Client.Timeout instead of context cancel for quick test.

maria: can you test a patch: upgrade to go-sdk v0.10.1 (contains retry fix that respects ctx and closes bodies), or as a stopgap set: 

```
\tt.DisableKeepAlives = true
\tt.IdleConnTimeout = 5 * time.Second
\tclient.Timeout = 1 * time.Second
```

kevin: also ask them to run pprof to confirm goroutine blocks, and send a tcpdump showing many half-closed connections. we should get: go env, netstat -anp | grep :443, and the reproduction test script.

david: forwarded repro + netstat, pprof, tcpdump. customer needs urgent help, >10% errors in prod.

maria: I escalated to eng-runtime and attached the traces. Eng: note the retry middleware uses a new request created from original context — confirm it checks ctx.Err() before trying and always closes resp.Body on non-nil errors.

support-bot: Escalation created: #INC-2026, assigned to eng-runtime, priority P1.

kevin: initial recommended fix for customer: roll back to v0.8.4 or bump to v0.10.1, apply DisableKeepAlives workaround, and add a connection cleanup cron (CloseIdleConnections every 30s). I'll prep a patch PR to ensure retry path calls resp.Body.Close() and respects request context. :+1:

david: thanks — I'll send the upgrade instructions and keep monitoring. :eyes:
